newsitem.title: USA: Freshstart Venture Capital 6-mth net up.
newsitem.headline: Freshstart Venture Capital 6-mth net up.

text.p: Freshstart Venture Capital Corp said net income for the first six months ending Nov. 30, 1996 was $191,017 versus $178,550 for the six months ending Nov. 30, 1995, an increase of 7.0 percent.

Net income per share for the six months ending Nov. 30, 1996 was 15 cents versus net income per share of 14 cents for the prior comparable period, an increase of 7.0 percent. Weighted average common shares outstanding for both periods was 1,096,688 shares.
Total revenues for the six months ending Nov. 30, 1996 were $522,245, an increase of 3.5 percent compared to revenues of $504,361 for the six months ending Nov. 30, 1995.
These results do not give effect to the company's recent public offering with respect to the sale of 1.076 million shares of common stock at $5.00 per share, which was completed on Dec. 3, 1996.
